title: Uniqueness of varying-ring ordinary pullback evaluation
statement: The Lean declaration `lem-sp-varying-ring-module-eval-g-uniqueness` has the displayed unit-normalized ordinary pullback evaluation statement.

proof.text: Use naturality with the system adjunction unit, cancel the invertible direct-image evaluation comparison, and apply the level adjunction hom-equivalence to identify the two component maps.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleEvalG_unique {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (d e : pull R φ f ⋙ eval R φ X n ≅
      eval R φ Y n ⋙ StrictTower.modulePullback (R n) f)
    (hd : ∀ N : Modules R φ Y,
      (eval R φ Y n).map ((moduleAdj R φ f).unit.app N) ≫
        (moduleEvalP R φ f n).hom.app ((pull R φ f).obj N) ≫
        (StrictTower.moduleDirectImage (R n) f).map (d.hom.app N) =
      (Scheme.proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction f (coefficients R Y n)
        (coefficients R X n) (StrictTower.constantRingIso (R n) f)).unit.app
          ((eval R φ Y n).obj N))
    (he : ∀ N : Modules R φ Y,
      (eval R φ Y n).map ((moduleAdj R φ f).unit.app N) ≫
        (moduleEvalP R φ f n).hom.app ((pull R φ f).obj N) ≫
        (StrictTower.moduleDirectImage (R n) f).map (e.hom.app N) =
      (Scheme.proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction f (coefficients R Y n)
        (coefficients R X n) (StrictTower.constantRingIso (R n) f)).unit.app
          ((eval R φ Y n).obj N)) :
    d = e
